mcqs.q: How did Hitler come to power in 1933?
options: He was legally appointed Chancellor by President Hindenburg as part of a conservative political deal, after the Nazis became the largest party in the Reichstag.
The NEP was introduced by Stalin to fund the Five-Year Plans.
Hitler won an outright majority in the 1932 presidential election.
Hitler seized power through a violent coup or revolution.

mcqs.q: What did Brown v Board of Education decide in 1954?
options: Brown v Board ended slavery in the southern states.
The Supreme Court ruled that 'separate but equal' schools were inherently unequal, overturning Plessy v Ferguson and beginning legal dismantling of school segregation.
Hitler won an outright majority in the 1932 presidential election.
Brown v Board of Education immediately desegregated all schools in America.
